added_failures_source: Derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs. baseline_suite log gate-base.log (revision 8702883ad00f6379077e3482b41f1cb292213819): 39 passed, 0 FAILED/ERROR lines. after_suite log gate-head.log (revision 49d25e64b): 40 passed, 0 FAILED/ERROR lines. Head-minus-base failing-id set difference = 0 ids; I re-ran tests/test_attempt_exit_waits_for_its_worker.py at the reviewed head 326adf19245ac3c65407d0e23684a4cc190e466e (1 passed EXIT=0), so the zero-added-failure conclusion holds at the revision under review.

findings.text: the signal short-circuit records an exit as soon as the spawned child ends by signal even if the worker it adopted lives on, so a launcher killed by signal whose worker is still running would record the attempt early; the measured defect (a launcher that exits voluntarily) does not exercise this path.

the wait covers every child of the supervisor, so a normally-exiting adopted worker that leaves a live reparented descendant holds the exit record through that descendant under the manifest grace; the second commit's short-circuit covers only the signal case.

the recorded head gate ran at 49d25e64b, one docs-only commit before the reviewed head 326adf19245ac3c65407d0e23684a4cc190e466e, so the recorded suite figure is not at the revision under review; my head re-run of the case passed, so the zero-added-failure conclusion is unaffected.

item_verdicts.goal: the supervisor becomes a child subreaper before it spawns, so a launcher that exits ahead of its worker leaves the worker parented to the supervisor; the exit record waits for it; achieved and verified at 326adf19245ac3c65407d0e23684a4cc190e466e.

justifications.durability: the declared mutation (RECKON_ATTEMPT_EXIT_NEGATIVE_CONTROL=write-at-launcher-exit) makes the case fail at EXIT=1, which I reproduced at head; the os.WIFSIGNALED short-circuit from 49d25e64b has no test of its own.

justifications.fit: reuses _reap_worker_on_its_terminal_manifest, the terminal-manifest grace and the stop bound unchanged, and reads /proc parentage rather than inventing a record.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal is that an attempt's exit record waits for the worker it launched to end, and it holds at 326adf19245ac3c65407d0e23684a4cc190e466e: the supervisor becomes a child subreaper before the spawn (dispatch.py:9434), _reap_the_launched_worker (dispatch.py:9336-9390) waits on the adopted worker under the same terminal-manifest grace and stop bound, and the exit record carries worker_pid=worker_pid (dispatch.py:9496).
